name: agile
description: Disciplined agile/XP mode. Talk before you code, then drive it through outside-in TDD in small steps, refactor to simple design, and speak plain domain language.

interface.shortDescription: Agile/XP discipline: understand first, test-first always
interface.longDescription: Treats a request as a conversation before code, then drives the change outside-in: one failing acceptance test, small red/green/refactor cycles, refactor to simple design, plain domain language throughout.
defaultPrompt: Let's agree on the behaviors for this feature before writing code.
Refactor this to simple design without changing behavior.
